Once, and inspired from telescopic essays I documented the seeds of the article, so you might only want to read that:

> Artificial Intelligence is not Intelligence Augmentation

https://hyper.dev/2026/ai-without-ia/

Where I describe that a language (such as most if not all Scheme) are missing the tooling to make easy human and agent symbiosis possible. The agent can hack its way to working code by the way of burning tokens at great speed, but the human needs a debugger, traceback, readable proofs, etc...

Python has almost all of those, except content-addressing / function identifier by their content. So, I benchmarked whether AI can handle the workflow associated with multilingual code bases. And the answer is: yes!

#python #multilingual #programming
